visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a traditional Taiwanese noodle shop storefront. The exterior is decorated with small dark red tiles. A large vertical sign on the left and menus on the upper wall display prices and items. Various cooking equipment and a stainless steel prep station are visible. (2) A male cook with glasses and a white headband is shown from the chest up, lifting a large batch of yellow noodles over a steaming pot in a well-lit kitchen environment. His facial expression is focused. (3) Close-up shot of a red bowl containing soup noodles, garnished with green onions and pork ribs. A red plastic spoon is used to lift some of the dark brown broth. (4) The camera shifts to a macro close-up of a piece of braised pork rib with cartilage being held by black chopsticks, showing its tender texture and moisture. (5) A hand is seen using a small metal spoon to scoop chopped pickled vegetables from a container into a small pink plastic dish. (6) High-angle close-up of noodles being lifted from the soup with chopsticks, steam rising from the bowl. (7) Close-up of a white bowl containing dry noodles topped with thin slices of cooked pork and a dark savory sauce. (8) Close-up of a square piece of dark-colored pig's blood cake (rice cake) covered in sauce and topped with a single green onion. (9) A brief panning shot reveals the shop's interior with simple stainless steel tables and red plastic stools in a brightly lit, clean indoor setting. (10) The final scene shows the storefront again with two female customers standing near the counter, one wearing a motorcycle helmet, while text overlays provide the shop's address and brand name.
